text:
Mia Chen: Quick kickoff — launching a hybrid search + retarget push to support next week's webinar. Goal CPL <= $45, daily budget target $8,000 initial. Need final bids, creative set, and inbound lead routing before 10am PST. :rocket:
Samir Patel: timeline? landing page & tracking ready?
Mia Chen: Landing page is live (LP_v3). GTM tags and GA4 events validated. Need final ad copy variants and confirmation on retarget window.
Devraj P: Recommend bid ramps by hour: 00-06: -20%, 06-12: +15%, 12-18: +25%, 18-24: 0. Use CPV-style caps for Shopping/search combos. Also enable accelerated pacing first 48h then switch to smoothing.
Lucy (Growth): For retargeting shrink to 7d for high-intent LP visitors (visited /pricing or /register). Use 30d for general site visitors but lower bid multiplier. Creative refresh: rotate hero image + headline every 72h, but keep one control creative throughout.
AdsBot: QC Report: missing landscape 1200x628 for creative variant B. Account alert: audience size for 7d list = 14.2k.
Samir Patel: I'll upload the missing creative now. Naming convention: adv_hybrid_pulse_v1_A/B, use utm_campaign=hybrid-pulse-v1, utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc. Also set final ad group names: search_core, search_brands, retarget_7d, retarget_30d.
Mia Chen: Routing — we want webinar registrants to go to: HubSpot list "Webinar_Attendees_2026-03-25" and immediately trigger nurture flow. If demo intent (visited /request-demo) tag and route to SDR queue.
Devraj P: For deduping leads set rule to 72h dedupe window and prefer first-touch for attribution.
Mia Chen: Webhook payload example for inbound routing (please validate):
```
POST https://hooks.example.com/hubspot
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "source": "paid_search_hybrid",
  "campaign": "hybrid-pulse-v1",
  "tags": ["webinar_attendee"]
}
```
Samir Patel: payload looks good. We'll add `utm_campaign` and `gclid` passthrough. Also add `dedupe_window_hours":72` param to the webhook wrapper.
Lucy (Growth): Creative cadence note — if a creative underperforms CTR by >20% vs control after 48h, swap it out early. Keep one creative reserved as 'backup' for quick swaps.
AdsBot: Alert: projected spend day 3 = $12.2k based on current pacing. Recommend implementing spend throttle rule to avoid overspend.
Mia Chen: Ok — action items: Samir to set pacing rule (cap daily at $8k, pause campaigns if CPA > $60 for 6h), Devraj to implement bid ramps and audience filters, Lucy to finalize creative variants and upload backup, Samir to validate webhook passthrough to HubSpot and gclid. If everyone is green we start creative upload at 10:00 PST and push live tonight. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: On it, will DM once pacing rule is in place and post screenshots.
Lucy (Growth): Uploaded creative backups to the folder and added naming sheet. All set from my end.
Mia Chen: Thanks team — happy path looks good. If AdsBot still flags overspend after throttle we'll reduce max bids by 10% tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
